vc_checking.summary: All three current manual VCs are semantically proofable. The entry VC splits xizi_dll immediately before the designated node and frames the fresh-node link cells. Each return VC chooses its complete-resource first disjunct and reassembles the updated predecessor/sentinel, fresh node, designated node, and suffix into xizi_dll. One bounded group captures their shared split/recompose helper family.

natural_language_analysis.summary: Each antecedent owns exactly the circular-list pieces needed by its consequent after structural induction over prefix. The entry VC has a complete xizi_dll whose abstract list fixes the designated-node boundary. The return VCs explicitly own the updated predecessor/head, fresh-node, designated-node, suffix, and (when nonempty) prefix resources. No annotation or seed-spec strengthening is required.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ linklist_pre :: suffix), plus separate undefined node_next/node_prev cells for fresh linklist_node_pre
vc_shape.pre_exists: first/last and all segment link endpoints hidden by xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg
vc_shape.post_spatial: a spatial orp: for prefix=nil, updated-boundary-ready head links, linklist_pre links, suffix segment, and framed fresh cells; for prefix=prefix0++[prev], sentinel links, prefix0 segment, prev links to linklist_pre, linklist_pre links, suffix segment, and framed fresh cells
vc_shape.post_pure: left branch: prefix=nil, prev=head, before_prev=last; right branch: prefix=prefix0++[prev]

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Open xizi_dll and induct over prefix. When prefix=nil, instantiate prev=head and before_prev=last and expose the first list cell at linklist_pre. When prefix is nonempty, retain its last node as prev, its predecessor as before_prev, and the preceding nodes as prefix0; expose linklist_pre and its suffix segment.
witnesses.space_plan: Use a group-suffixed split helper proved by induction over prefix. Keep both fresh-node cells as an untouched frame. Unfold xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg only to expose sentinel, predecessor, designated-node, and suffix resources, then select the appropriate spatial orp branch.
witnesses.pure_plan: The list expression prefix++linklist_pre::suffix supplies the split position. The nil/cons induction gives prefix=nil or prefix=prefix0++[prev]. The dllseg definition supplies non-null/non-stop facts for each actual list node; no arithmetic is needed.
candidate_helper_declarations: xizi_dll_split_before_target (proved in group-local case_lib with group suffix)
premise_discharge: The target boundary is fixed by the antecedent list prefix++linklist_pre::suffix.
All resulting fields and segments are partitions of xizi_dll; no ownership is invented.
The two fresh-node cells are present separately and remain framed.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the decomposition direction of the same boundary transformation that the return VCs reverse.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: sentinel links head->first/head.prev=last; prefix0 segment first..prev; updated prev links to fresh/before_prev; fresh links to target/prev; target links to next/fresh; suffix segment next..head
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ fresh :: target :: suffix) in the first Coq-disjunction alternative
vc_shape.post_exists: xizi_dll hides first and last, instantiated by the antecedent's endpoints

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the first outer disjunct. Instantiate final xizi_dll first/last with the antecedent values and rewrite prefix with PreH1. The final segment is prefix0 followed by prev, fresh, target, then suffix.
witnesses.space_plan: Fold field pairs into links, concatenate prefix0 segment with the prev, fresh, and target cells and the suffix segment, pair the result with the unchanged sentinel links, and apply xizi_dll_close. A group-suffixed reassembly helper can package the segment induction.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite PreH1 and normalize app_assoc/app_cons. Required dllseg guards follow from the valid separated predecessor/fresh/target field stores; if two bases alias incompatibly the antecedent is inconsistent. No arithmetic is involved.
candidate_helper_declarations: xizi_dll_recompose_insert_before (proved in group-local case_lib with group suffix)
premise_discharge: Every sentinel, prefix, prev, fresh, target, and suffix resource consumed by reassembly occurs explicitly in P.
Validity/separation of the owned field pairs discharges the dllseg node guards.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the nonempty-prefix reassembly case using the same helper family as the entry split and empty-prefix return.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: updated head links head->fresh/head.prev=last; target links next/fresh; suffix segment next..head; fresh links target/head
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head (nil ++ fresh :: target :: suffix) in the first Coq-disjunction alternative

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the first outer disjunct. Substitute first=linklist_pre, prefix=nil, prev=head, and before_prev=last. Instantiate final xizi_dll with first=fresh and the antecedent last endpoint.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the updated head pair as sentinel links, unfold two nonempty dllseg cells for fresh and target, reuse the existing suffix segment, and close xizi_dll. This is the empty-prefix specialization of the reassembly helper.
witnesses.pure_plan: Substitute PreH1-PreH4 and simplify nil++fresh::target::suffix. Non-null/non-stop guards follow from the separated fresh/target/sentinel stores; no arithmetic is needed.
candidate_helper_declarations: xizi_dll_recompose_insert_before (proved in group-local case_lib with group suffix)
premise_discharge: first=target is PreH1, prefix=nil is PreH2, prev=head is PreH3, and before_prev=last is PreH4.
The updated sentinel, fresh-node, target, and suffix resources are exactly the resources required by the folded list.
Validity/separation of the field stores discharges dllseg guards.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the empty-prefix specialization of the same reassembly transformation as return_wit_1.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Induction over a prefix xizi_dllseg to split or reassemble a circular doubly linked list immediately before one designated node.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Expose/fold sentinel links and concatenate or separate prefix, predecessor, fresh-node, target, and suffix segments while preserving exact ownership.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Classify prefix as nil or prefix0++[prev], rewrite the generated prefix equalities, and obtain dllseg guards from the list representation and separated node stores.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three same-function targets share one tightly coupled structural helper family; count 3 is below the controller maximum 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove a group-suffixed split/recompose helper pair by induction on prefix. Use the split direction for entail_wit_1 while framing the fresh stores. For each return witness choose the complete-resource first disjunct, rewrite the prefix equations, and use reassembly plus xizi_dll_close.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses share the same function and xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg split/reassembly helper family; one 3-witness group is minimal and within max_witnesses_per_group=12.

group_plan.grouping_reason: One bounded group is the minimal exact-cover plan because all targets share one structural helper family.
